title: A Summit for the Trail
author: T. M. Eriksen
blurb: Vesper Joubert, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
